action.new_text:
# Compute sums over horizon
    sum_with = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    sum_call_only = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    sum_no = np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Margins as per Toolformer loss filter:
    # margin_no_call  = loss(no_call) - loss(with_result) = sum_with - sum_no
    # margin_call_only = loss(call_only) - loss(with_result) = sum_with - sum_call_only
    margin_no_call = sum_with - sum_no
    margin_call_only = sum_with - sum_call_only

    # Keep if both: margin_no_call > tau_filter, margin_call_only > 0
    keep_mask = (margin_no_call > tau_float) & (margin_call_only > 0.0)
    return keep_mask, margin_no_call
